answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 31417 Country: India Title: Praying with dried Mazi Question: If my clothes are soiled with mazi with an amount greater than a rupee coin (the hollow portion of palm), and if I pray with these clothes on without washing thrice, is my Salaah valid? Answer ID: 31417 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 707/707/M=1432) In the case mentioned above, it is necessary to wash off the impurity (mazi); Salah will not be lawful without washing it: وعفا الشارع عن قدر درھم وان کرہ تحریما، فیجب غسلہ وما دونہ تنزیھا فیسن وفوقہ مبطل فیفرض (الدر المختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
